ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly polarized distribution with approximately 5% high-intensity white pixels (scars/barnacles) against a 95% low-intensity black background on the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a continuous solid black pigmentation. Distinct high-contrast white circular blobs are mapped in clusters: a four-point cluster on the mid-left lobe, a six-point cluster on the mid-right lobe, and high-density clusters at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an obtuse interior angle measured at approximately 130 degrees relative to the lobe junctions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations across both lobes; a significant high-amplitude, jagged indentation is present on the right lobe's trailing edge, approximately two-thirds distance from the notch to the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curves extending from the median notch, terminating in slightly posterior-oriented, pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters (5-15 pixel diameter) consistent with barnacle attachment sites, densely distributed across the entire surface and concentrated at the leading edges and tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of several thin, unaligned, high-intensity linear marks (scratches) visible on the lower-center and left-mid regions of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular traumatic indentation/loss of tissue on the trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive circular scarring from parasitic or epibiotic colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of white circular marks contrasting against a near-total Type 1 (black) pigmentation background.
